mettle.keyword.brutal.set.4: Critical hits knock back half again as far and daze for 0.5 s.
mettle.keyword.brutal.set.6: Overkill: damage beyond what kills a mob spills onto the nearest enemy within 4 blocks (up to 10).
mettle.keyword.deep.set.2: Below y 0: dig 5 % faster, take 5 % less damage.
mettle.keyword.deep.set.4: Below y 0, hostiles notice you 25 % closer.
mettle.keyword.deep.set.6: Underdark: in light 4 or less you regenerate half a heart every 5 s, and your first hit from the dark on a mob is a critical (10 s cooldown).
mettle.keyword.echo.set.6: Reverberate: when a perk with a cooldown fires, one time in four it is ready again at once.
mettle.keyword.ember.set.2: Fire and lava hurt you 15 % less.
mettle.keyword.ember.set.4: Melee hits set the target alight one time in eight (3 s); campfire food heals 1 heart when eaten.
mettle.keyword.ember.set.6: Kindled: taking fire damage makes you Kindled for 8 s: +15 % damage, your hits ignite, and you burn for at most 2 s (30 s cooldown).
mettle.keyword.gale.set.2: Fall 1.5 blocks more before taking damage.
mettle.keyword.gale.set.4: Arrows and thrown things fly 10 % faster; sprint-jumps +10 %.
mettle.keyword.gale.set.6: Updraft: jump once more in mid-air before you land (8 s cooldown).
mettle.keyword.hex.set.2: Your cursed cards' downsides are 25 % smaller.
mettle.keyword.hex.set.6: Pact: once every 5 minutes a killing blow leaves you on 4 hearts with Strength I and Speed I for 8 s, and takes 3 max hearts until you next sleep.
mettle.keyword.hoard.set.4: Blocks and mobs drop one more of something one time in 25.
mettle.keyword.hoard.set.6: Magpie: loot chests you open first roll one extra time one time in four; Hearth markets give you 5 % more edge.
mettle.keyword.iron.set.6: Ironskin: the first hit you take every 8 s is 3 damage lighter (after armour).
mettle.keyword.keen.set.4: Your first hit on a target at full health is a critical, once per target.
mettle.keyword.keen.set.6: Weak Point: three hits on one target within 4 s expose it: it takes +20 % from everyone for 4 s (10 s per target).
mettle.keyword.kin.set.2: Allies within 8 blocks gain 5 % more skill XP.
mettle.keyword.kin.set.4: You and allies within 8 blocks regenerate 10 % faster.
mettle.keyword.kin.set.6: Rally Cry: sneak and swing an empty hand: allies within 16 blocks get Speed I and Strength I for 8 s (90 s cooldown).
mettle.keyword.swift.set.4: +5 % attack speed and bow draw speed.
mettle.keyword.swift.set.6: Slipstream: after 3 s of sprinting, your next hit or shot within 2 s deals +30 % and doesn't break your sprint.
mettle.keyword.tide.set.4: Mine at full speed under water; thrown tridents +10 %.
mettle.keyword.tide.set.6: Undertow: in water or rain you deal +15 %, every hit slows the target for 1 s, and you see clearly under water.
mettle.keyword.warden.set.4: Allies within 6 blocks take 8 % less damage (the best Warden in range counts).
mettle.keyword.warden.set.6: Bodyguard: when an ally within 6 blocks would take more than 4 damage, you take a third of it instead (4 s cooldown).
mettle.keyword.wild.set.2: Animals you kill and wild plants you pick give 10 % more.
mettle.keyword.wild.set.4: Your tamed animals near you take 25 % less damage and deal 15 % more.
mettle.keyword.wild.set.6: Feral: on natural ground (outside settlements) you regenerate as if well fed and move 8 % faster.
mettle.trait.athletics.burden_wise.descr: You become Burdened %s points later (75 % → 75 + X).
mettle.trait.athletics.deep_lunged.descr: You hold your breath %s s longer.
mettle.trait.athletics.featherfall.descr: You fall %s more blocks before taking damage.
mettle.trait.athletics.long_winded.descr: After 10 s of sprinting, +%s speed until you stop.
mettle.trait.athletics.pacesetting.descr: Allies sprinting within 8 blocks of you move %s faster.
mettle.trait.athletics.surefoot.descript: Soul sand, honey, powder snow and cobwebs slow you %s less.
mettle.trait.blades.ambushing.descriptio: Blade hits on a mob that isn't targeting you deal %s more.
mettle.trait.blades.bleeding.description: Critical blade hits make the target bleed %s damage over 3 s.
mettle.trait.blades.bloodied.description: Below half health, blades swing %s faster.
mettle.trait.blades.finishing.descriptio: Blade hits on targets below 30 % health deal %s more.
mettle.trait.blades.fleet.description: You move %s faster while holding a blade.
mettle.trait.blades.flourishing.descript: A blade kill gives you %s speed for 3 s.
mettle.trait.blades.grounded.description: %s less knockback while you hold a blade.
mettle.trait.blades.honed.description: Swords and spears lose durability %s less often.
mettle.trait.blades.parrying.description: Holding a blade (not blocking), a melee hit is turned aside for half its damage %s of the time.
mettle.trait.blades.taunting.description: A mob you hit with a blade turns on you instead of an ally %s of the time.
mettle.trait.blades.tempo.description: Each hit on the same target within 1.5 s of the last swings %s faster, up to 3 stacks.
mettle.trait.blades.thirsting.descriptio: You heal %s of the blade damage you deal (at most 1 heart a second).
mettle.trait.blades.trophy.description: Blade kills drop one more of their loot %s of the time.
mettle.trait.defense.arrowcatcher.descri: Arrows and other projectiles hurt %s less.
mettle.trait.defense.recovering.descript: After 5 s without being hurt, you regenerate %s faster.
mettle.trait.defense.resolute.descriptio: Harmful effects on you last %s less.
mettle.trait.defense.shielding.descripti: While you block, players within 4 blocks take %s less damage.
mettle.trait.defense.taunting.descriptio: While you block, a hostile within 8 blocks attacking an ally turns on you %s of the time.
mettle.trait.defense.thorned.description: Melee hits your shield blocks hurt the attacker for %s of the hit.
mettle.trait.heavy_weapons.charging.desc: Your first heavy hit after 2 s of sprinting deals %s more.
mettle.trait.heavy_weapons.cleaving.desc: %s of an axe hit spills onto one enemy beside the target.
mettle.trait.heavy_weapons.crushing.desc: Heavy hits ignore %s of the target's armour.
mettle.trait.heavy_weapons.headtaker.des: Heavy kills drop the mob's head %s of the time.
mettle.trait.heavy_weapons.raging.descri: Each hit you take gives +%s damage for 5 s, up to 3 stacks.
mettle.trait.heavy_weapons.rooted.descri: %s less knockback while you hold a heavy weapon.
mettle.trait.heavy_weapons.shieldbreaker: Heavy hits keep a raised shield down %s longer.
mettle.trait.heavy_weapons.splitting.des: Logs you chop drop one more %s of the time.
mettle.trait.heavy_weapons.staggering.de: Heavy hits daze the target for 0.5 s %s of the time.
mettle.trait.heavy_weapons.unshaken.desc: Slowness and Weakness on you last %s less while you hold a heavy weapon.
mettle.trait.heavy_weapons.unworn.descri: Axes, maces and tridents lose durability %s less often.
mettle.trait.marksmanship.headhunting.de: Arrows that hit the head deal %s more.
mettle.trait.marksmanship.marking.descri: A target you hit takes %s more damage from everyone for 3 s.
mettle.trait.marksmanship.piercing.descr: Arrows pass through their first target %s of the time.
mettle.trait.marksmanship.poised.descrip: After you stand still for 1 s, arrows deal %s more.
mettle.trait.marksmanship.retrieving.des: Arrows drop back from what they kill %s of the time.
mettle.trait.marksmanship.steady.descrip: Your shots spread %s less while you move.
mettle.trait.marksmanship.swift_flighted: Arrows fly %s faster (they drop less at range).
mettle.trait.marksmanship.thrifty.descri: Arrows aren't used up %s of the time.
mettle.trait.marksmanship.twinned.descri: A shot looses a second arrow beside the first %s of the time (it uses one).
mettle.trait.marksmanship.winged.descrip: Arrows deal %s more to flying mobs.
mettle.trait.mining.cavern_wise.descript: Mobs hurt you %s less while you are below y 0.
mettle.trait.mining.echoing.description: Breaking an ore also breaks one touching ore of the same kind %s of the time.
mettle.trait.mining.geodic.description: Amethyst buds and clusters drop one more shard %s of the time.
mettle.trait.mining.greedy.description: Metal ores drop one more raw metal %s of the time.
mettle.trait.mining.haulers.description: Stone, ore and raw metal weigh %s less for you.
mettle.trait.mining.lucky.description: Gem ores (diamond, emerald, lapis, redstone, quartz) drop one more %s of the time.
mettle.trait.mining.netherborn.descripti: Netherrack, blackstone, basalt and ancient debris break %s faster.
mettle.trait.mining.rockbreaker.descript: Stone-like blocks (stone, deepslate, tuff, granite…) break %s faster.
mettle.trait.mining.seamfinder.descripti: The first ore of each vein drops one more %s of the time.
mettle.trait.mining.stonehide.descriptio: Falling blocks, dripstone, magma and suffocation hurt %s less.
mettle.trait.mining.surefooted.descripti: Digging while climbing, swimming or in the air is %s less slow.
mettle.trait.smithing.edged.arsenal: Blades and heads you forge deal %s more.
mettle.trait.smithing.lightened.arsenal: Armour and parts you forge weigh %s less.
mettle.trait.smithing.masterly.arsenal: A part comes out one quality higher %s of the time.
mettle.trait.smithing.masterly.descripti: A tool, weapon or armour piece you craft is a Masterwork %s of the time.
mettle.trait.smithing.menders.arsenal: Anvil and smith repairs restore %s more durability.
mettle.trait.smithing.proofing.descripti: Armour you craft gets +%s toughness a piece.
mettle.trait.smithing.signature.descript: Goods marked "Forged by you" sell for %s more at Hearth markets.
mettle.trait.smithing.steady_handed.arse: The anvil's strike window is %s wider.
mettle.trait.smithing.steady_handed.desc: Anvil jobs cost %s fewer levels (never below 1).
mettle.trait.smithing.tempered.descripti: Tools and weapons you craft last %s longer.
mettle.trait.smithing.thrifty.arsenal: Forging returns a nugget %s of the time.
mettle.trait.smithing.thrifty.descriptio: A recipe with ingots gives one back %s of the time.
mettle.trait.survival.antidote.descripti: Poison and Hunger on you last %s less.
mettle.trait.survival.beastfriend.descri: Your tamed animals near you deal %s more and take %s less.
mettle.trait.survival.butchering.descrip: Animals drop one more meat %s of the time.
mettle.trait.survival.cooks.description: Food you cook comes out one extra %s of the time.
mettle.trait.survival.fireside.descripti: Campfire Rest and campfire cooking work %s faster.
mettle.trait.survival.foraging.descripti: Wild plants and berries give a bonus item %s of the time.
mettle.trait.survival.skinning.descripti: Animals drop one more hide, leather, wool or feather %s of the time.
mettle.trait.survival.thornwalker.descri: Berry bushes and cacti hurt %s less.
mettle.trait.survival.wayfaring.descript: You move %s faster on paths and roads.
